# [PR #3252] [Testing] Drop duplicated codegen-smoke tests; fix fastmath self-comparison assertions

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3252
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-19T17:44:09Z
labels: 

## 正文



<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary

- Removed duplicate CPU and LLVM codegen-smoke tests for `matmul` and `T.gemm`.
- Deleted the standalone fastmath CUDA test module.
- Fixed math tests that compared fastmath output with itself.
- Added reference implementations for `exp10`, `log2`, `log10`, `cos`, `sin`, and `tan`.
- Used deterministic inputs for `tan` and relaxed its tolerance to `rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2`.
- Unsupported math operations now raise `AssertionError` instead of using self-comparison.

## Testing

Test execution results were not provided.
